# Introduction

This week focuses on bringing the final project together and communicating the results effectively.

# Learning goals

1. Refine project analysis and results

2. Improve data visualizations and communication

3. Connect findings to agricultural applications

4. Prepare a clear and reproducible final project

# Lecture - Communicating Data Science

Guidance on presenting data, visualizing results, and communicating technical findings to an agricultural audience.

# Lab - Final Project Work

Teams refine their analysis, visualizations, documentation, and final deliverables.

# Discussion - Project Feedback

Teams review project progress and receive feedback on their final direction.

# Assignment

Continue final project development and prepare materials for final submission.

# Looking ahead

Next week will be the final major development period before **project submission and course wrap-up**.
